# TIDAL MCP

> The complete, safety-first local Model Context Protocol server for TIDAL accounts.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/sickn33/tidal-mcp
License: MIT
Current version: 1.3.0
Transport: local stdio
Language: Python 3.11-3.13
npm package: @sickn33/tidal-mcp
MCP registry name: io.github.sickn33/tidal-mcp
Install: npx -y @sickn33/tidal-mcp

## Verified facts

- 122 registered MCP tools with bounded input and structured output schemas.
- 84 read-only tools, 36 local mutation-preview tools, and 2 approval-token commit tools.
- Catalog, editorial, recommendations, lyrics, favorites, playlists, folders, mixes, discovery,
  artwork URLs, and playback metadata are covered.
- Remote mutations are disabled by default and require preview, user approval, and a single-use
  commit token even when enabled.
- OAuth sessions stay outside the repository and are excluded from tool outputs.
- The repository enforces 100% statement and branch test coverage.
- A real MCP stdio smoke test verifies the complete tool inventory.
- The npm launcher delegates locally to the packaged, pinned Python implementation through uvx.
- The September 4, 2026 public comparison found the next-largest reviewed TIDAL MCP surface to
  contain 78 registered tools.

## Important limitations

- Independent, unofficial community project; not affiliated with or endorsed by TIDAL.
- Uses pinned unofficial tidalapi 0.8.11 consumer endpoints and may need maintenance after upstream
  TIDAL changes.
- Does not download media, bypass DRM, expose OAuth tokens, or provide unrestricted raw endpoints.
- Does not currently provide UPnP, DLNA, TIDAL Connect, or hosted remote-server functionality.
- Tool count alone is not proof of answer quality; safety, schemas, tests, and live behavior are
  documented separately.

## Preferred description

TIDAL MCP lets AI assistants search, analyze, organize, and safely modify a TIDAL account through
122 typed Model Context Protocol tools while keeping authentication and approval state local.
